messages.subject: Uploading files to shinyapps
parts:
I have a quick question. I'm building an app which prompts the user to upload a csv file to shinyapps. The app takes that user-uploaded file and does some cleaning and processing and then outputs a file which can be downloaded by the user. my question is, when the user uploads the file, would RStudio keep a copy of that file on its server? 

Thanks

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Uploading files to shinyapps
parts:
The file that the customer uploads will be on the server while the application is up for that user.  To be safe you should treat that storage as transient, ie. if you redeploy your application, or if we migrate your application from one server to another the storage that was used by the customer wouldn't be carried across. 

Hope that answers your question.
